leftEvidence.title: Leaders give willingly for the house

points.label: Solomon-relative action
points.left: David gives from royal and personal treasure and invites leaders to consecrate themselves by giving.
points.right: David praises God as giver of kingdom, riches, and strength, says the people have given what already belongs to God, and asks for Solomon to receive a whole heart to obey and build.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Leaders, officers, and the people rejoice because gifts are offered willingly.
points.right: The assembly’s generosity is interpreted as divine gift and becomes the setting for prayer about Solomon’s inner loyalty.

payload.posture: The people give abundantly, and David interprets the wealth as God’s own before asking that Solomon’s inner loyalty match the outward provision.

rightEvidence.title: David asks for Solomon’s whole heart

payload.tension: Resources sufficient for the house cannot supply the faithful heart required of its builder.
payload.title: Willing gifts and the prayer for a whole heart
